description: This file declares utility functions, data structures, and constants used in the LibXDiff library for file differencing. It includes function prototypes for hashing, diff record emission, buffer management, and line analysis.

methods.name: xdl_bogosqrt
methods.description: Calculates the integer square root of a long integer.

methods.name: xdl_emit_diffrec
methods.description: Outputs a diff record with provided content, size, prefix, and callback.

methods.name: xdl_cha_init
methods.description: Initializes a chastore_t structure with specified size and count.

methods.name: xdl_cha_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a chastore_t structure.

methods.name: xdl_cha_alloc
methods.description: Allocates memory from a chastore_t structure.

methods.name: xdl_guess_lines
methods.description: Estimates the number of lines in a memory-mapped file.

methods.name: xdl_blankline
methods.description: Checks if a line is blank based on size and flags.

methods.name: xdl_recmatch
methods.description: Compares two records/lines for match based on flags.

methods.name: xdl_hash_record_verbatim
methods.description: Computes a hash of a record without considering whitespace.

methods.name: xdl_hash_record_with_whitespace
methods.description: Computes a hash of a record considering whitespace based on flags.

methods.name: uint64_t xdl_hash_record(uint8_t const ** data,uint8_t const * top,uint64_t flags)
methods.description: Hashes a record with or without whitespace based on flags.

methods.name: xdl_num_out
methods.description: Converts a long value to its string representation.

methods.name: xdl_emit_hunk_hdr
methods.description: Emits a header for a diff hunk.

methods.name: xdl_alloc_grow_helper
methods.description: Helper function to grow an allocation buffer.

ctags.name: xdl_hash_record
ctags.pattern: /^static inline uint64_t xdl_hash_record(uint8_t const **data, uint8_t const *top, uint64_t flags)$/
